title: AI-ready biological data: $1.8B global commitment
summary: A major global initiative has committed $1.8 billion to make biological data AI-ready, expanding the Virtual Biology Initiative to accelerate computational biology research. This represents a significant investment in data infrastructure for training AI models on biological datasets.
problem_solved: Making vast amounts of biological data structured and accessible for AI/ML model training and analysis
why_valuable: This $1.8B commitment addresses the critical bottleneck of AI-unready biological data, enabling breakthroughs in drug discovery, genomics, and precision medicine
